findings: Sequential ID race condition — Two concurrent registration requests can generate the same sensor ID because MAX(id) query and INSERT are not atomic. Add SELECT FOR UPDATE or switch to UUIDs in production.

Token exposure in plaintext response — Registration endpoint returns token in 201 response body, visible in logs and network traffic. Require HTTPS in production and configure log redaction for token field.

Stationary sensor assumption — Backend accepts coordinate changes on every reading without validation. If a sensor reports wildly different coordinates, the map location jumps. Add coordinate drift detection if mobile sensors become a requirement.

UI 'Awaiting first data' ambiguity — Frontend shows 'Awaiting first data' for sensors with null coordinates but doesn't distinguish between 'never reported any reading' and 'reported readings without coordinates.' Acceptable for MVP where contributed sensors always include coordinates.
